message.title: Documents
message.body: These documents cover the {total} claim payment from {sender}, shared between you and the other co-payees. Open each one, read it through and select Next to mark it as Done.

documents.name: Multi-Party Settlement Statement
documents.description: The settled claim amount, the co-payees entitled to share in it and the initial allocation between them.

documents.name: Payment Allocation Agreement
documents.description: How the co-payees accept, change or dispute the allocation, and what happens if it isn’t accepted before the expiry date.

documents.name: Co-Payee Authorization
documents.description: Your authorization for the jointly payable claim to be paid as separate shares, one to each co-payee.
